item.text:
**Working judgment:** Strongly negative. In 2023 Putin repeatedly framed the war as a civilizational struggle, labeled Ukrainians/the West as Nazi-like enemies, and used ethnicized slurs against Zelensky. The best counterevidence is limited to generic peace-talk language, not a real restraint pattern.

| Claim | Source | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Sacred civilizational struggle against the West | Reuters via ThePrint, *Putin says Russians are united in ‘sacred’ battle with West over Ukraine* | 9 May 2023 | https://theprint.in/world/putin-says-russians-are-united-in-sacred-battle-with-west-over-ukraine/1563461/ | Putin cast the war as a “sacred” fight, said a “real war” had been unleashed against Russia, and accused the U.S. and allies of forgetting WWII. That is classic scapegoating and mobilization of grievance against the West. | 3B.3, 2B.6, 2B.2 |
| Nazi framing of Ukraine and escalation rhetoric | VOA/Reuters, *Putin Evokes Stalingrad to Predict Victory Over ‘New Nazism’ in Ukraine* | 2 Feb 2023 | https://www.voanews.com/a/putin-evokes-stalingrad-to-predict-victory-over-new-nazism-in-ukraine-/6945589.html | Putin described Ukraine as being in the grip of a “new Nazism,” tied the conflict to Stalingrad memory politics, and said Russia was ready to draw on its full arsenal. This is dehumanizing wartime rhetoric aimed at legitimizing violence. | 3B.3, 2B.6, 2B.2 |
| Ethnicized slur against Zelensky | Reuters via Ynet, *Putin attacks Jewish heritage of Ukraine’s Zelensky* | 16 Jun 2023 | https://www.ynetnews.com/article/h1mvh11qv2 | Putin said Zelensky was a “disgrace to the Jewish people” and repeated the line that Western leaders had installed a Jew to conceal Ukraine’s “anti-human essence.” This is explicit ethnicized scapegoating and antisemitic insinuation. | 3B.3, 2B.6 |
| Repetition of the antisemitic line and Holocaust inversion | Reuters via investing.com, *West put Jewish Zelensky at head of Ukraine to hide Nazism, Putin says* | 5 Sep 2023 | https://jp.investing.com/news/world-news/article-677482 | Putin again claimed the West put a Jewish Zelensky in charge to cover up “the glorification of Nazism,” while invoking the Holocaust in a way that blurred blame onto Jews themselves. This strengthens the case for personal incitement through ethnic grievance and historical inversion. | 3B.3, 2B.6 |
| Domestic enemies framed as terrorists/extremists | Reuters via Investing.com, *Putin tells FSB security service to raise its game against Western spy agencies* | 28 Feb 2023 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-tells-fsb-security-service-to-raise-its-game-against-western-spy-agencies-3017413 | Putin ordered the FSB to stop “sabotage groups” and counter “terrorist or extremist cells” linked to Ukraine and the West. That is not ethnic hatred, but it does personally legitimize hostile treatment of opponents and dissidents. | 3B.3, 3B.2 |
| Internal betrayal language against Wagner | Reuters Connect, *MOMENT: Putin says Wagner mutiny is ‘treason’ in televised address* | 24 Jun 2023 | https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/moment-putin-says-wagner-mutiny-is-treason-in-televised-address/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjM6bmV3c21sX1ZBMjQwMTI0MDYyMDIzUlAx | Putin labeled the Wagner rebellion “treason,” said Russia would protect its people from threats “from the inside,” and framed challengers as betraying the nation. This is personal vilification of internal opponents, though narrower than ethnic incitement. | 3B.3, 3B.2, 2B.5 |
| Weak counterevidence: conditional peace language | Kremlin, *Putin said Russia was ready for negotiations* | 28 Jul 2023 | https://special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/71826 | Putin said Russia was ready for talks and that African proposals deserved attention, but he kept the terms wholly conditional and offered no real softening of the hostile framing above. This is the best restraint-adjacent material I found, but it does not offset the inciting rhetoric. | 3B.3, 2B.7 |
| Weak counterevidence: generic dialogue language | Kremlin, *Joint statement with Xi on Ukraine* | 21 Mar 2023 | https://special.kremlin.ru/supplement/5920 | The joint statement welcomed dialogue and warned against uncontrolled escalation. This is pro-talks language, but it is generic diplomacy rather than evidence that Putin stopped personally scapegoating opponents or minorities. | 3B.3, 2B.7 |

**Search gap:** I did not find credible 2023 evidence of Putin personally condemning hate speech or explicitly discouraging dehumanization. The strongest available counterevidence is only conditional diplomacy language, while the dominant record is repeated scapegoating of Ukrainians, Jews, the West, and internal “traitors.”
